record.question: Which of the following is an example of an internet-based service relevant to a radiology department?
options: Accessing the hospital's Picture Archiving and Communication System (PACS) from an onsite workstation.
Using a web browser to view departmental on-call schedules.
Remotely interpreting a study from a home office using teleradiology software.
Accessing the hospital's radiology information system (RIS) for a patient's history.
record.explanation: Official final key: C — Remotely interpreting a study from a home office using teleradiology software.. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 8, printed Q65. Source limitation: Two choices describe internet-based services relevant to radiology. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
